artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross by Torchlight
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in an activity involving a figure draped in a cloth. The drawing shows figures arranged in a solemn and dynamic composition. The central focus is on figures interacting with a draped cloth. The background is darker, accentuating the central figures. The use of shading and cross-hatching creates texture and depth, adding to the serious atmosphere of the scene. The style displays characteristics of chiaroscuro, highlighting the contrasts between light and dark.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures gathered around a dimly lit space. Most of the bodies are visible, though some are obscured by shadows or overlapping figures. In the central part of the image, several people are positioned around a figure lying down, who seems to be covered in a shroud. The individuals around this figure exhibit detailed facial features, with long beards and some with long hair. The lighting highlights their expressive faces, emphasizing wrinkles and furrows. The clothing appears to be robes or draped garments. None of the figures are visibly holding objects or wearing jewelry. The background is predominantly dark, suggesting an enclosed, perhaps subterranean setting with large arching shadows on the walls.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people around a bed. One person is lying on the bed, partially covered with a sheet, with their face sketched with closed eyes. Other individuals around the bed are looking towards the person. Their faces are mostly shadowed, wearing robes or draped clothing. One person is seated and seems to embrace a child, while another figure stands slightly bent with hands clasped. The scene is in a dimly lit space with minimal visible background details.

artworks.title: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Smaller Plate
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals captured from the waist up. The central figure is seated at a desk, turned slightly toward the viewer with papers in front of him, and he is using a quill in his right hand. This individual has a round face with a mustache and short, straight hair, and a small cap rests on his head. He wears a dark garment with a lighter inner shirt and prominent buttons. To his right stands a younger person with a curious expression, looking toward the seated figure. The child has longer hair and wears a dark top with a white collar. Surrounding the two figures is an interior setting featuring a window to the man's left, through which light filters, casting shadows. A candle and a drafting square are visible on the desk. On the wall behind them is artwork or religious imagery and architectural details, lending a sense of depth and ambiance to the space.

artworks.title: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Smaller Plate
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man sitting at a table, facing slightly towards the viewer. He has a round face, short hair, and wears a dark garment with a white collar. The man holds a quill pen in his right hand and rests his left hand on a piece of paper. Behind him is a younger individual with long hair looking downwards. The setting is indoors near a window, with a candlestick on the window sill.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Road beside a Canal
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with structures, vegetation, and a sky above. On the right horizon, there are distant structures. Trees and shrubs line the horizon. The scene is sketched with etching techniques, using fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The grayscale palette focuses on black and white contrasts. A path runs next to water on the left, bordered by trees and thatched-roof buildings. Shrubs, trees, and a road extend into the distance. Sparse tree branches frame the composition.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Reading in an Italian Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.1 x 21.2 cm (10 1/4 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching featuring a scene from an elevated viewpoint. A figure in flowing attire is seated on the lower left. Next to them is a large tree with detailed foliage. In the center, a lion stands on a rocky landscape. In the distance, there are farmhouses and rustic buildings, with a church possibly visible. The horizon separates the land from the sky. The etching uses fine brushstrokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia tones.

artworks.title: Clump of Trees with a Vista
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cluster of trees and foliage. The horizon is low, mostly hidden by the trees. A small structure is seen on the right side, and the horizon is slightly visible in the far right. The artwork uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture in the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black on a light background. Darker lines define details closer to us, while lighter strokes suggest distance.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (?) with Plumed Cap and Lowered Sabre
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a person shown from the chest upwards. The individual faces forward with a direct gaze. They have distinct facial features with a mustache and beard. The person has long, curly hair that falls to their shoulders and wears a feathered hat. They are dressed in a dark garment with decorative elements. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain and shaded, with circular lines suggesting an oval framing. The artist's signature and the date "1643" are inscribed on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a bed with celestial figures above. The scene depicts a group of figures in elaborate garments surrounding a draped bed. Above them, celestial or ethereal figures appear to be emerging from or descending with clouds or smoke. The detailed line work and use of shading enhance the expression and movement within the composition. The intricate rendering of fabric and texture adds depth and drama to the scene.

artworks.title: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Larger Plate
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of an elderly man seated. He is facing slightly to his right, turning his head towards the viewer. The man has a broad face with a slightly furrowed brow and short, light hair that appears thinning on top. He is dressed in formal, dark attire with a large white collar around his neck, holding a quill in his right hand and a large piece of paper in his left. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the figure's features and clothing. The setting has a formal atmosphere with a dark tone, directing the viewer's focus to the seated man.

artworks.title: Christ Preaching (The Hundred Guilder Print)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on Japan paper
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and deep, velvety shading on tan-colored paper, a man, Jesus, stands at the center of a crowd of more than two dozen people, mostly adults and a few children, in this horizontal etching and drypoint. Jesus is left of center. He stands facing us, but he turns his head to look to our left. Rays of light emanate from behind his head against the towering cave opening that surrounds him. His curly hair falls long over his shoulders, and he holds both hands out. His eyes are lightly incised, giving them an almost blurred look. A crowd of people lie or kneel to our right. Some use crutches or walking sticks, and some are on carts. All the people appear to have pale skin except for one with darker-toned skin to the right in this gathering. That person has a rounded nose, full lips, and wears an earring that gleams brightly in the deep shadows. A camel stands at the far side of this group under an arched opening. The people standing and one person sitting close to Jesus to the left are fully shaded, and those farther left are lightly outlined and sparsely shaded so they appear to be much lighter on the white paper. Close to Jesus are a woman holding a baby, a seated, clean-shaven young man, and several bearded men. Most of those who are along the left edge of the sheet wear turbans or floppy caps.

artworks.title: Christ Crucified between the Two Thieves (The Three Crosses)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 39 x 45.5 cm (15 3/8 x 17 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene with a central figure on a cross, surrounded by various figures on the ground including some on horses, with a crowd gathered around. The drawing is in the style of Rembrandt, featuring intense light and shadow to emphasize the central figure and create depth. Lines radiate from the center, suggesting movement and drama within the composition. Dark, shaded areas surround the central scene, focusing the viewer's attention on the highlighted figures and significant activity occurring around them.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate: Large Plate
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 55.2 x 44.9 cm (21 3/4 x 17 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals engaged in an interaction. At the center is a man with a crown on his head. Surrounding him are others dressed in elaborate robes and headdresses, some kneeling or gesturing. One individual is seated on a chair with an outstretched arm. Many wear period-specific hats and gesture toward various elements. The background includes architectural details like walls, arches, and a column with a statue.

artworks.title: Christ Carried to the Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession carrying a figure through a rocky landscape. Shrouded individuals are depicted transporting a human figure on a stretcher. The scene is detailed with line work and shading. In the background, there are textured lines suggesting rocky cliffs or terrain. The drawing showcases traditional etching techniques.

artworks.title: The Shepherd and His Family
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene depicting a shepherd with a broad hat, standing and leaning on a staff, alongside another individual who is seated. Nearby, a small flock of sheep is resting. In the background, the land rises into hills with a few visible buildings against the horizon. The sky is softly depicted with a few light clouds. The etching technique shows detailed textures in the foliage and clothing through delicate, fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily featuring dark brown, black, and pale tan tones.

artworks.title: Student at a Table by Candlelight
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a table, with only their upper body visible. The individual is leaning slightly forward with one hand raised to their forehead. Their facial features are not clearly visible due to the low lighting. They have dark hair partially covered by a cap and are wearing a garment with a fur collar or lining. An open book is in front of them on the table, along with a closed book and some papers. A candle on a holder is casting light on the table. The background is dark, emphasizing the intimate and focused setting around the person.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross: a Sketch
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting a crucifixion. The drawing features a composition centered around a large wooden cross on which a figure is hanging. There are several other figures around the cross, some engaged in actions related to the crucifixion. The scene is characterized by intricate lines and shading, typical of sketches or etchings, that suggest movement and expression. The style and detail reflect a dramatic and emotional narrative captured in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the gravity of the scene.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus: Small Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man with outstretched arms in front of a group in a rocky environment. The style features intricate line work detailing the rocky surroundings and the clothing of the figures. Vegetation is present in the rocks. The figures are positioned to suggest interaction, possibly portraying a moment of revelation or instruction. Shadow and cross-hatching are used to add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Girl with a Basket
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body profile of a person standing, facing left. The individual has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and wears a cap that covers most of their head, with some hair visible at the back. They wear a long-sleeved garment with a layered appearance, and hold an object with one hand while carrying a container on one arm, possibly a basket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man in an Arbor
artworks.description: The image contains a three-quarter view of a seated person drawn in an etching style with intricate facial features, including a prominent nose, expressive eyes, beard, and mustache. The figure wears a wide-brimmed hat, a heavy garment, and there is no visible jewelry. The background includes lightly etched foliage and an indistinct architectural element. The signature and date "Rembrandt 1642" are inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Woman at a Door Hatch Talking to a Man and Children (The Schoolmaster)
artworks.description: The image features two individuals at the center. One person leans slightly forward towards the other, showing their profile. They have short, possibly tousled hair covered by a headscarf and are wearing earrings and draped clothing. The other person, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, also leans towards them. Both figures are depicted in a shadowy, intricately detailed background suggesting an enclosed space with arched detailing and a vertical line reminiscent of a doorway or window.

artworks.title: Man Drawing from a Cast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stone bust of a child and an elderly face illuminated by candlelight. The drawing shows the stone bust of a child with elongated neck and pronounced features placed on a ledge. Beside the bust, there is a figure with an aged face and a flat cap illuminated by a candle. The background is rich with hatching and cross-hatching, providing texture and depth to the architectural elements and shadows. The lines vary in thickness, creating a contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Card Player
artworks.description: The image displays an etching of a person's upper body in a seated pose. The individual has a tired, lined face with closed eyes, a straight nose, and loose lips. They have long, unkempt hair under a hat, and wear a loose garment with flowing sleeves. The person holds a paper or document with both hands. The background consists of dense, hatched lines for contrast.
